records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:37 — Saving a host without a category overwrites the server-defaulted Uncategorized category with findById(null), leaving the row without a displayed category until reload.
records.rationale: The component's save() does host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))) after host.save(props). If the user leaves the category chooser empty, categoryId is null; the server's save_host defaults category_id to SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id and returns that, but the client then overwrites the host record's category with findById(null) (likely null), so category-badge renders blank until reload. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: server defaulting in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb vs. unconditional findById(clientId) in embeddable-host.js.es6 save().
